params.body:
The README was the untouched Laravel boilerplate. This one says what the repo itself says: what the site is and how one codebase serves two brands through SANITY_BRAND, the content mirror refreshed by the Sanity webhook, the stack, the one environment from elixir.json and the canonical-host redirect, the two composer scripts that set up and run everything, the variables by group, the tests and what CI publishes for Elixir, every artisan command and what routes/console.php schedules, and the routes Forge and Elixir read.

Two things the repo made me say plainly: ci.yml still starts a MySQL service that phpunit.xml overrides with sqlite in memory, and .env.example carries no Nightwatch or Elixir entries although the config reads them; the README names those from the config files.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
params.title: README: what the repo says about itself
